environment.description: Worker nodes in isolated private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) with no NAT gateway or IGW attachment. Celery broker and result backend accessible only through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint (PrivateLink) with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/celery-worker-role. Security group sg-0fedcba987654321 on the VPC endpoint allows inbound TCP/6379 only from sg-0abcdef123456789 (worker nodes). No route table entry for 0.0.0.0/0 exists in the subnet's route table rtb-0112233445566. The gateway service that dispatches tasks is in a separate VPC (vpc-0aabbccdd) peered via PCX but the peering connection's route table only permits traffic to 10.0.128.0/20 on port 6379. Task results are consumed internally; no HTTP endpoint or proxy exposes raw task return values or timing metadata externally. CloudWatch metrics publish only aggregate p50/p99 latencies per 60-second window.

config.route_table: rtb-0112233445566 - local route only + VPC endpoint prefix list

security_groups.worker_sg: sg-0abcdef123456789 - egress to vpce SG only on 6379
security_groups.vpce_sg: sg-0fedcba987654321 - ingress from worker SG only on 6379

config.external_exposure: none - no ALB, no API GW, no public IP
config.monitoring: CloudWatch 60s aggregate only, no per-request timing exposed
